Pretty axis breaks inclusive of extreme values, from a range

Source: R/scales.R
extended_range_breaks_.Rd

extended_range_breaks_() was deprecated in ggthemes 8.0.0. Use extended_range_breaks() instead: extended_range_breaks_(dmin, dmax, n) is extended_range_breaks(n)(c(dmin, dmax)).

Usage

extended_range_breaks_(
  dmin,
  dmax,
  n = 5,
  Q = c(1, 5, 2, 2.5, 4, 3),
  w = c(0.25, 0.2, 0.5, 0.05)
)

Arguments

dmin

Minimum of the data range.

dmax

Maximum of the data range.

n

Desired number of breaks.

Q

Set of nice numbers.

w

Weights applied to the four optimization components (simplicity, coverage, density, and legibility).

Value

The vector of axis label locations.
